text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Giving it her absolute all, Gold City 
triumphed over Tamamo Cross in the 
Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, Tamamo Cross shared her 
thoughts. She had taken a liking to Gold 
City's fierce competitive spirit and had 
looked forward to battling her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, when the opportunity finally 
arrived, Gold City had lost her old 
fighting spirit. She felt frustrated 
watching her get tossed around by the 
opinions of others.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she can sense Gold City's 
sincerity now. She told her that simply 
wanting to run is a perfectly fine reason.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold City seeks an even more serious 
contest. Thus, she decided to enter the 
Japan Cup, where the "Monster" Oguri Cap 
awaits.
